name: md-code-links
description: Jump from Markdown to C/C++ source: clickable path:line links plus clangd-powered go-to-definition for identifiers inside code blocks and inline code.

mdCodeLinks.enableFunctionJump.description: Enable clangd-powered function-name jump (F12 / Ctrl+Click) inside Markdown code blocks and inline code.

mdCodeLinks.prewarmIndex.description: Start clangd in the background when a workspace with compile_commands.json is opened, so the symbol index is ready sooner.

mdCodeLinks.clangdPath.description: Optional absolute path to the clangd binary. Empty = auto-detect (/usr/lib/llvm-*/bin/clangd, PATH).
